observed.caption: A calm pond reflects trees and a tall tower under a clear sky, framed by overhanging branches.
observed.description: In the foreground a grassy bank with scattered brown fallen leaves borders a large calm pond that fills the middle of the image and reflects the sky, trees and a tall building. Across the water a dense line of mature trees with dark green canopies stretches horizontally, and behind the treeline in the center distance a tall light-colored high-rise building with a pointed top rises above the canopy. Overhanging branches with small green leaves hang from the top left and top right edges against a pale clear sky that gradients to lighter near the horizon, with soft warm daylight illuminating the scene and creating a mirrored reflection of the building and treeline on the water surface. A small low light-colored structure is partially visible through the trees on the far right shore.
